title: John C NDE 2926
content: I had gone with my dad to pick up my car at this motel where I had lent it to a person I knew hoping to sell it. I had picked up the car and my dad took off in his car. I pulled out of the parking lot and my car stalled in the south bound lane. I took off my seat belt and was about to turn on the emergency flashers when this old 1968 Impala broadsided my 1973 Ford Pinto on the driver's side. I heard he was going about forty-five miles an hour when he hit me. I was thrown out of the car and onto the pavement. I was gasping for air and I guess somebody called the ambulance, which took me to the emergency room at Bass Baptist Hospital. I was taken in when I lost consciousness and found myself hovering near the ceiling looking down at my body on the table below. I saw the doctors using the paddles trying to revive me. I was then pulled down this strange tunnel and into this brightly lit area where four men dressed in white robes were and they were all white looking. One came towards me and I glided over to another room where this being (I know it was God) was seated on a throne. This very bright light was streaming out from him, I could only make him out for an instant, and he had long hair and a beard. The light was intense and I could feel that he was concerned for me and I could feel a lot of love the likes of which I haven't felt before and I felt he had great compassion for me and had knowledge about everything that had been and whatever was to be. I saw gold streaking with the bright white light also and knew all wealth comes from him too. It seems like I was with him for about three minutes and then I was glided back over to the four gentlemen who were by this very tall white fence. One of them then told me it was not my time yet and before I could tell them that I didn't want to go back here, I was in my body in the hospital gasping and choking with this tube in my throat. The nurse came over and removed the tube and I told her I was hungry. She gave me an injection in my IV and the next day I found I was out for three days. The days that followed, I had some insight and gifts I hadn't had before. It seemed I could almost tell what people were up to and feeling. I also had visions of things to come. I had a vision two weeks before the space shuttle Challenger blew up. I saw a white light around my dad two weeks before he died. I asked God at one point to take these gifts from me because they were too upsetting for me. I haven't had too many visions since I asked him this. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1982 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) I thought after the experience that the wreck might have been an attempt on my life. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness When I was before God's throne. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was before God's throne. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was bright where I was, but no sunlight just the light of God. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes A strange looking tunnel. Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes When I got out of the tunnel these four men who were all white complete with white robes. And God on his throne. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Bright place with the light of this being (God). Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love and understanding. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? From the world's future Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I used to be liberal. Now I'm adopting more conservative Christian values. What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I used to be liberal. Now I'm adopting more conservative Christian values. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes After I left the hospital. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Want more to do with Godly people. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I know now that there is a God and he is Love. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I knew that there was a God and he can do miracles. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.religious_figure_detail: God seated on a throne; long hair and a beard; very bright light streaming out from him; felt love, compassion, concern; knowledge about everything that had been and whatever was to be.
arrival.other_being_detail: Four men dressed in white robes; all white looking.

environment.environment_other_detail: Brightly lit area; another room with God on a throne; gold streaking with the bright white light; very tall white fence.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car stalled and was broadsided; thrown out; taken to emergency room; resuscitation attempted with paddles.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered four men in white robes; then God on a throne; then returned to the four men by a tall white fence before being sent back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room, then tunnel, then brightly lit area with four men, then another room with God, then back to the four men at a tall white fence, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Gold streaking with the bright white light; very tall white fence as a barrier; later requested God to remove upsetting gifts and had fewer visions afterward.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I know now that there is a God and he is Love.”
